start.text: It's contained. The insider is stopped, but now we have to see what he left open.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. But stopped is not fixed. The access is still open, the account still works, and there is a person in all this.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Anything he touched is still open, or still broken. We can't let people go back to work yet.
B.name: Carla

C1.text: Walk through the office and look for machines marked with a [b][color=red]![/color][/b]. Close the access first, then the account, then bring the file back.
C1.name: Carla

C2.text: No. We ask him in private, with HR there, and we listen. He may have a reason, and it cannot be taken back once it is said.
C2.name: Carla

D.text: Fix one thing at a time. When everything is repaired, we run a [b][color=green]final check[/color][/b].
D.name: Carla

E.text: Got it. Close the access, then the account, then talk. I want the truth, and I want to be fair.
E.name: Joshua
